message:
As we navigate the hustle and bustle of daily life, it’s easy to overlook the simple joys of being prepared. We recently stumbled upon a great resource about car safety and emergency readiness that reminds us of the importance of being aware while on the road. 🚗

Rediscovering low-tech fun in our preparations can be a great way to connect with our families. Consider making it a family activity to discuss what to keep in our cars for unexpected moments. We’d love to hear your favorite tips or tricks for car readiness!
